```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
titanic = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a count plot for survival based on class and gender
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(data=titanic, x='class', hue='survived', palette='pastel')

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class')
plt.ylabel('Number of Passengers')
plt.title('Survival Count by Passenger Class and Gender')
plt.legend(title='Survived', loc='upper right', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
